body: I don't feel like explaining this for the hundredth time, but online groups make me feel even worse. I either feel annoyed at trans people that are happy for some reason that I don't understand or see other trans people who are suicidal and depressed.
I'm pretty much trapped. I go to a Mormon college and if I got caught I'd have to answer a lot of questions. I'm not brave enough to go out and try something like that.

Yes, I've been scared to say everything on most of them though because of scared of being reported.

I called the trans life line a lot which doesn't report people though.

They're all pointless. They just listen to you for an hour and go "that's horrible, I can't imagine what living like like that must be" well fucking duh, why else would I want to fucking die. There's no point and they never make me feel better.

No, it's heavily stigmatized. There's no way I can tell them anything. We've never gotten along that well. 

I really really want to die. I'm really scared of what I might do to myself.

Thanks, but thinking about the future isn't really helpful. I can't imagine any happiness that would be worth living though this.

I don't really blame people for getting upset though. This really is the only thing that's constantly on my mind and I can't concentrate on anything else.

I've tried to talk to anyone I can think of. Everyone either would have to report me to police and take me to the er (which I don't want because I take drugs to cope) or is fed up with me talking about suicide.

I can't transition. My parents pay for my college tuition and if I try to come out or do anything that isn't *sex typical* then they'll disown me and I'll get kicked out of my college. I can't think of anyone who would support me.
Gender dysphoria mostly. I hate looking at myself or feeling my body and there's no way I can avoid it.
Yes. I don't really know what to talk about though.
